text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks just because they have risen can cut short further gains; I should consider each holding’s outlook rather than focus only on my average cost.","Holding stocks through declines without reassessing them can let losses grow; I should review the reasons for owning each position, even when I check infrequently.","Account value can fall despite earlier gains, so I should pay attention to overall risk and diversification instead of reacting only to recent price moves."]}
